statements.A: users trust what the app shows them
statements.B: a read reflects the write that just happened
statements.C: the app answers during a network partition
statements.D: reject writes when the cluster loses quorum
statements.D': answer every request from the nearest replica

assumptions.text: a user whose own write vanishes stops trusting the app
an error page costs more trust than a stale feed
every screen needs the same consistency
assumptions.evidence: the feed carried 30 seconds of lag for a year unnoticed; the balance screen did not

assumptions.text: answering from a replica is always safe

injections.text: make the balance linearizable and let everything else be eventual
injections.rationale: the trust budget is spent where the money is
